idea-plugin.name: JTools
idea-plugin.description:
JTools is a powerful and lightweight plugin management container designed specifically for JetBrains IDEs. It revolutionizes the plugin development experience by providing hot-plugging capabilities, allowing developers to install, update, and uninstall plugins without restarting the IDE.

IDE compatibility: One installation package supports builds 251.0–263.* (IntelliJ Platform 2025.1–2026.3), including platform JCEF on older IDEs and the Web Browser (JCEF) plugin on 2026.2+.

📖 Documentation(Skills provided, after installation you can let AI develop the jtools plugin) | 🐛 Report Issues | 📦 Releases

✨ Key Features

  • 🔌 Hot-Plugging Support: Install and uninstall plugins on-the-fly without IDE restart, significantly improving development efficiency.
  • 📦 Drag & Drop Installation: Simply drag plugin files into the panel for instant installation, with right-click context menu for easy uninstallation.
  • 🚀 Multi-Language Development: Full support for Java, Kotlin, and JavaScript plugin development with rapid debugging capabilities.
  • 📂 Customizable Storage: Configure your preferred plugin installation directory with automatic isolation by JetBrains product and version.
  • 📋 Integrated Logging: Built-in logging console with soft-wrap output for easy troubleshooting during development and runtime.
  • 🤖 Coding Session: Project-scoped coding dialog rewritten around message events, with streaming replies, reasoning, tool timeline, append/queue, attachments, async context compaction, and incremental live updates.
  • 🧩 Coding Environment: Sessions bind a coding environment as the capability pack for system prompt, tools, plugin functions, skills, multimodal view_* tools, and compaction agent.
  • 📂 Project-Scoped Capabilities: Configure MCP services, Skills, and SubAgents for a specific project and its development workflow. Project-specific tools, instructions, and subagents are available only within that project, keeping each project’s capabilities focused and isolated.
  • 🔍 Image Preview: Preview Markdown and attachment images with zoom and rotation, and copy or download images through the IDE host.
  • 📊 Context Metrics: Token usage, turn/step counts, tool calls, and context window occupancy appear under the composer, with a dedicated context compaction dialog that runs in the background.
  • 🧭 Provider Manager: Multi-provider configuration (OpenAI/Anthropic) with base URL, headers, and proxy.
  • 🎛️ Provider Selector: Provider selector with model lists fetched from each provider.
  • 🧩 Provider Templates: OpenAI-compatible provider types and vendor templates with preset endpoints and parameter hints for easier third-party model integration.
  • 🌍 Broad Provider Coverage: Built-in templates for OpenAI, DeepSeek, GLM, OpenRouter, SiliconFlow, DashScope, Gemini, Ollama, and Anthropic-style integrations.
  • 🧰 Function Calling: Aggregated plugin and system tools with unique identifiers to avoid name conflicts.
  • 🧩 Structured MCP CLI Tool: A single cli tool covers MCP server configuration, connection tests, resource reads, and tool calls, with a doc command returning the full MCP command reference.
  • 🔌 MCP Client: Manage and call external MCP servers over stdio/SSE/streamable HTTP on the official MCP Java SDK, with persisted server configs and connection testing.
  • 📦 Plugin Ops: Local/URL/batch install and uninstall tool calls for faster workflows.
  • 🧪 Dev Testing: Developer panel can expose current plugin instance tool calls for debugging.
  • 🐞 Isolated Sandbox Debugging: Reuses the current host JetBrains IDE and its installed JTools to launch a separate debug process. Supports temporary plugin loading, Swing automation, JVM breakpoints, JCEF/CDP debugging, and screenshots; process isolation is not an OS security sandbox.
  • 📎 Attachment Workflow: Attach local files and images to chat, with model-aware capability checks, clipboard support, and optimized upload handling.
  • 🖼️ Multimodal Inputs: Per-model capability switches for image, audio, video, and file attachments, with automatic text extraction for readable files.
  • 🧠 Skill Management: Import or edit local SKILL.md skills, attach them per session, and expose skill resources directly to the agent runtime.
  • 📚 Skill Resources: references/examples/scripts resources can be mounted into agent sessions and read through dedicated resource tools.
  • 🔗 Skill Runtime Integration: Skills share the same runtime Toolkit as built-in and plugin tools, keeping SkillBox tool groups aligned with the active agent session.
  • 🎚️ Model Tuning: Configure per-model streaming, multimodal capabilities, and advanced OpenAI/Anthropic parameters from a dedicated tuning panel.
  • 🧾 Parameter Guidance: Store provider-level default and recommended parameters to make model configuration more repeatable across sessions.
  • 💾 Session Persistence: Restore sessions, draft attachments, and conversation context within the owning project for long-running collaboration.
  • 🧠 Runtime State: Session runtime can preserve memory, tool state, and planning context for more consistent multi-step workflows.
  • ⚙️ Agent Limits: Configurable max tool iterations and tool result size limits to prevent oversized context.
  • 📂 File Listing: jtools_list_files supports maxEntries with truncation metadata.
  • 🌐 HTTP WebFetch: WebFetch works as a direct HTTP client with GET/POST/PUT/DELETE/PATCH/HEAD/OPTIONS, query params, headers, raw bodies, form params, timeout control, and Web tool proxy settings.
  • 🧭 AI Browser Tools: Browser tools can open a temporary JCEF browser session, run visible or hidden after user choice, read pages, observe element refs, click, type, wait, capture screenshots, and destroy the dynamic tool window when finished.
  • 🔧 Dynamic SDK Management: Automatic SDK dependency resolution for IDEA, Maven, and Gradle projects.
  • 🌐 Web Integration: JavaScript plugins enable flexible web page integration with custom development options.
  • 🪟 Multi-Instance Support: Open multiple instances of the same plugin simultaneously with proper resource management.
  • 📐 Split Panel View: Support for left-right panel splitting for better workspace organization.
  • 🎯 JetBrains Family Support: Compatible with the entire JetBrains IDE family including IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm, PyCharm, and more.

🎯 Use Cases

  • Rapid prototyping and testing of IntelliJ plugins
  • Creating lightweight utility tools without full plugin overhead
  • Developing custom web-based tools integrated into the IDE
  • Building team-specific development tools with easy distribution
  • Connecting private or third-party model services through vendor templates without rebuilding the plugin workflow

🚀 Getting Started

  1. Install JTools from the JetBrains Marketplace
  2. Open the JTools panel from the right sidebar
  3. Drag and drop your plugin files or use the built-in development tools
  4. Start developing with hot-reload support!
📖 帮助文档(已提供 skills，安装之后可让 ai 开发 jtools 插件) | 🐛 问题反馈 | 📦 版本发布

🛠️ JTools - 轻量级插件容器

JTools 是一个专为 JetBrains IDE 设计的强大且轻量级的插件管理容器。它通过提供热插拔功能彻底改变了插件开发体验，允许开发者在不重启 IDE 的情况下安装、更新和卸载插件。

IDE 兼容范围：同一个安装包支持 251.0–263.*（IntelliJ Platform 2025.1–2026.3），同时支持旧版平台内置 JCEF 和 2026.2+ 的 Web Browser (JCEF) 插件。

✨ 核心特性

  • 🔌 热插拔支持：无需重启 IDE 即可即时安装和卸载插件，显著提升开发效率。
  • 📦 拖拽安装：只需将插件文件拖入面板即可立即安装，右键菜单轻松卸载。
  • 🚀 多语言开发：全面支持 Java、Kotlin 和 JavaScript 插件开发，具备快速调试能力。
  • 📂 自定义存储：可配置首选的插件安装目录，按 JetBrains 产品和版本自动隔离。
  • 📋 集成日志：内置日志控制台，支持软换行输出，便于开发和运行时故障排查。
  • 🤖 编码会话：按项目工作区重写的编码对话框，基于消息事件时间线，支持流式回复、推理、工具时间线、追加/排队、附件、异步上下文压缩和增量实时更新。
  • 🧩 编码环境：会话绑定编码环境作为能力包，统一管理系统提示词、工具、插件函数、技能、多模态 view_* 工具和压缩 Agent。
  • 📂 项目专属能力：面向不同项目的专属开发流程，新增项目级 MCP、Skills 与 SubAgent。项目定制的工具服务、技能指令和子代理仅在所属项目中可用，让能力配置更贴合项目需求，避免项目间相互干扰。
  • 🔍 图片预览：Markdown 图片与附件共用预览查看器，支持缩放、旋转，并通过 IDE 宿主复制或下载图片。
  • 📊 上下文指标：输入框下方动态展示轮次/步骤、工具次数、Token 用量和上下文窗口占用，上下文压缩在后台执行并以时间线通知结果。
  • 🧭 供应方管理：多供应方配置（OpenAI/Anthropic），支持 Base URL、请求头、代理。
  • 🎛️ 供应方选择：对话中可选供应方，并维护供应方级别模型列表与默认模型。
  • 🧩 供应方模板：支持 OpenAI Compatible 接入类型与厂商模板，预置端点和参数建议，便于接入第三方模型服务。
  • 🌍 广泛供应方覆盖：内置 OpenAI、DeepSeek、GLM、OpenRouter、SiliconFlow、DashScope、Gemini、Ollama、Anthropic 等接入模板。
  • 🧰 函数调用：聚合插件与系统工具并增加唯一标识，避免名称冲突。
  • 🧩 结构化 MCP CLI 工具：单一 cli 工具聚合 MCP 服务配置、连接测试、资源读取和工具调用，并通过 doc 一次性返回全部 MCP 命令参数说明。
  • 🔌 MCP 客户端：基于官方 MCP Java SDK 管理并调用外部 MCP 服务，支持 stdio/SSE/streamable HTTP 传输，服务配置持久化并可连接测试。
  • 📦 插件管理：支持本地/URL/批量安装与卸载的工具调用。
  • 🧪 开发测试：开发面板可暴露当前插件实例的工具调用用于调试。
  • 🐞 独立沙箱调试：复用当前宿主 JetBrains IDE 与已安装的 JTools 启动独立调试进程，支持临时加载插件、Swing 自动化、JVM 断点、JCEF/CDP 调试和截图；进程隔离不等同于 OS 安全沙箱。
  • 📎 附件工作流：对话支持本地文件和图片附件，具备模型能力校验、剪贴板支持与上传优化。
  • 🖼️ 多模态输入：可按模型开启图片、音频、视频、文件附件能力，并对可读文件自动抽取文本上下文。
  • 🧠 Skills 管理：支持导入或编辑本地 SKILL.md 技能，按会话挂载，并将技能资源直接暴露给智能体运行时。
  • 📚 Skills 资源：references/examples/scripts 等资源文件可随技能挂载，并通过专用资源工具读取。
  • 🔗 Skill 运行时集成：Skills 与内置工具、插件工具共享同一个运行时 Toolkit，使 SkillBox 工具组与当前智能体会话保持一致。
  • 🎚️ 模型调优：提供独立模型调优面板，可配置流式输出、多模态能力以及 OpenAI/Anthropic 高级参数。
  • 🧾 参数建议：支持保存供应方默认参数与推荐参数，让模型配置在不同会话中更容易复用。
  • 💾 会话持久化：在所属项目内保留会话、草稿附件与对话上下文，支持长会话持续协作。
  • 🧠 运行时状态：会话运行时可保留记忆、工具状态与规划上下文，适合多步骤连续任务。
  • ⚙️ 智能体限制：可配置最大工具调用轮次并限制工具返回长度，避免超大上下文。
  • 📂 文件列表：jtools_list_files 支持 maxEntries 并返回截断信息。
  • 🌐 HTTP WebFetch：WebFetch 改为直接 HTTP 客户端，支持 GET/POST/PUT/DELETE/PATCH/HEAD/OPTIONS、查询参数、请求头、原始请求体、表单参数、超时控制和 Web 工具代理。
  • 🧭 AI 浏览器工具：浏览器工具可创建临时 JCEF 浏览器会话，在用户选择后显示或隐藏运行，支持读取页面、观察元素 ref、点击、输入、等待、截图，并在完成后销毁动态工具窗口。
  • 🔧 动态 SDK 管理：自动解析 IDEA、Maven 和 Gradle 项目的 SDK 依赖。
  • 🌐 Web 集成：JavaScript 插件支持灵活的网页集成和自定义开发。
  • 🪟 多实例支持：支持同时打开同一插件的多个实例，并具备完善的资源管理。
  • 📐 分割面板视图：支持左右面板分割，更好地组织工作空间。
  • 🎯 JetBrains 全家桶支持：兼容整个 JetBrains IDE 系列，包括 IntelliJ IDEA、WebStorm、PyCharm 等。

🎯 应用场景

  • IntelliJ 插件的快速原型开发和测试
  • 创建轻量级实用工具，无需完整插件开销
  • 开发集成到 IDE 中的自定义 Web 工具
  • 构建团队专用开发工具，便于分发
  • 通过厂商模板快速接入私有或第三方模型服务，而不必重建整套插件工作流

🚀 快速开始

  1. 从 JetBrains Marketplace 安装 JTools
  2. 从右侧边栏打开 JTools 面板
  3. 拖放插件文件或使用内置开发工具
  4. 开始享受热重载开发体验！
idea-plugin.change-notes:
🚀 Version v1.1.6.0

Current Release / 当前版本

  • 📝 Readable Tool Results: Agent and coding sessions send readable text to the model and track success, failure and cancellation separately. Non-zero exits, HTTP errors, MCP failures and timeouts are not reported as successes. Original output and files for oversized results are preserved. The public plugin SDK and standalone Debugger MCP result contracts are unchanged.
  • 📂 Path-Only Native Resources: Native view tools accept only path, not attachment_id, removing their incompatible oneOf constraint. Attachments still start as metadata and load on demand; storage and UI references are unchanged.
  • 🔍 Tool Schema Diagnostics: Known OpenAI strict mode checks for oneOf before sending; when a compatible endpoint rejects a schema, the error identifies the tool by its index in that request. Plugin schemas are not silently rewritten.
  • 📦 Version Metadata: Plugin version 1.1.6.0 and SDK Helper marker 1160; the single-package IDEA 251–263 compatibility range is unchanged.
  • 📝 工具结果文本化：Agent 和编码会话向模型提供可读文本，成功、失败和取消单独记录。非零退出、HTTP 错误、MCP 执行失败和超时不再标为成功；保留原始正文和超限输出文件。插件 SDK 和独立 Debugger MCP 的对外返回契约不变。
  • 📂 原生资源只按路径读取：原生 view 工具只接受 path，不再接受 attachment_id，移除不兼容的 oneOf。附件仍先提供元数据、按需读取；附件存储和界面引用不变。
  • 🔍 工具 Schema 错误定位：已知使用 OpenAI 严格模式时在发送前检查 oneOf；兼容端点拒绝 Schema 时，按请求索引定位工具名，不静默改写插件定义。
  • 📦 版本元数据：插件版本 1.1.6.0、SDK Helper 标识 1160，IDEA 251–263 单包兼容范围不变。

🚀 Version v1.1.5.9-fix

  • 🐚 Bash Output Encoding: Decode stdout and stderr independently as UTF-8 or GBK to fix garbled Chinese output and decoding failures on Windows. Invalid byte sequences use UTF-8 replacement characters when neither encoding succeeds; delivered files remain UTF-8. Decoding never reruns commands and preserves exit, timeout and cancellation status.
  • 🪟 Windows Shell Detection and Guidance: Detect pwsh.exe and powershell.exe in PATH, preferring PowerShell 7, Windows PowerShell, then cmd. Tool guidance identifies the actual shell, launch mode and command syntax so the bash tool name is not mistaken for the active shell; user environment loading is retained.
  • 🩹 Invalid Tool Argument History: Fixed subsequent messages being blocked by historical tool calls with invalid arguments. Excludes invalid calls and their results when querying model history, before tool retention, history-turn selection and context budgeting, and excludes their history token usage. Covers OpenAI Chat Completions, Responses and Anthropic. Failure records remain visible; execution failures with valid arguments remain in model history.
  • 📄 Paged MCP Results: Large mcp.call results are saved as complete UTF-8 JSON, returning only a summary and file metadata. Read files in batches with normal Bash commands. The global mcp.call.max_output_chars defaults to 8000 with a minimum of 1024; original MCP error status is retained.
  • 🐚 File-Backed Bash Output: Agent and coding sessions save oversized stdout/stderr as UTF-8 temporary files, returning only execution status, a summary and file paths. Read files in batches with normal Bash commands without rerunning the original command. Output volume no longer terminates commands; timeout and cancellation remain active. Return limits default to 8000 with a minimum of 1024 characters.
  • 🧰 Project Tools: Removed IDE build and inspection tools. Use Bash with the project’s own build, compilation, packaging and checking commands; file editing, search and IDE formatting tools remain available.
  • 🧭 On-Demand CLI Help: Tool descriptions list short command purposes; doc provides an index and <command> --help returns detailed parameters.
  • 📂 Local Resource Paths: Markdown links, local media and native multimodal tools accept absolute paths outside the workspace. Relative paths still resolve against the session workspace; native resource tools also accept current attachment IDs.
  • 🖼️ Markdown Images: Images stretch to fill fixed thumbnail frames. The full-size viewer preserves aspect ratio, zoom, rotation, copy and download controls.
  • 🎛️ Model Parameter Layout: Advanced settings are grouped with responsive columns, improved Chinese labels and scrolling in short windows.
  • 🛠️ Standalone Plugin Development Skill: The repository provides a manually installed Skill with Maven, Gradle Shadow, IDEA Gradle Shadow and JS templates, plus SDK/Helper, lifecycle, multi-project state, multi-open panels, functions and packaging guides. No dedicated development tools or automatic Skill installer are added.
  • 🐞 Isolated Plugin Debugger: Added a sandbox debugger that runs a separate IDE process using the current host JetBrains IDE and its installed JTools plugin. It supports temporary plugin loading, Swing automation, JVM breakpoints, JCEF/CDP debugging, asynchronous operation queries, and screenshots; process isolation is not an OS security boundary.
  • ⏳ Async CDP While Debug Paused: Potentially pausing CDP calls can be submitted asynchronously and queried by operation ID. Released connections fail pending operations explicitly; timeout does not cancel or justify replaying actions.
  • 🔌 Debugger MCP: Debugger 0.2.0 exposes Streamable HTTP, legacy SSE and a standalone stdio adapter for external editors and AI clients. JTools AI sessions are optional; the runtime host still requires JTools and debugger. Shares one application-wide service across projects, synchronizes panels through Application MessageBus, and provides separate protocol tabs with one-click configuration copying, credential-scoped sandbox ownership and image results. Persists the actual port, enabled preference and client credentials under ~/.jtools/plugin-debugger/mcp.json; IDE restart restores an enabled service with its existing endpoint and credentials, while manual stop disables auto-start. Automatically discovers compatible JetBrains IDE products and JTools installations, not only IntelliJ IDEA.
  • 🔎 Sandbox Methods and Invocation: Added methods/invoke for inspecting and invoking live plugin instance methods and static methods using exact parameter types. Object references support chained calls, including plugin Function Calling lists and function objects, with worker/EDT execution and original exceptions. References expire on stop or reload. Update both JTools and the companion debugger JAR; request timeouts do not cancel or replay target calls.
  • 🔓 Public SDK and Sandbox Contracts: All SDK classes and members retain their names without obfuscation or shrinking. Fixed sandbox Logger implementation methods being removed during obfuscation, with build-time interface and release artifact checks.
  • 🧰 Tool and Resource Handling: Improved coding-environment tool selection and native resource handling, with regression tests.
  • 🌊 OpenAI Streaming Errors: Improved streaming error handling with focused tests.
  • 📚 Debugger Skill Guide: Added the debugger package and comprehensive host-IDE, lifecycle, Swing/JVM/JCEF, verification, and troubleshooting guidance. Automatically discovers existing JetBrains IDE and JTools installations; asks for custom paths or provides download links only when not found.
  • 📦 Version Metadata: Plugin version 1.1.5.9-fix and SDK Helper marker 1159; the single-package IDEA 251–263 compatibility range is retained.
  • 🐚 Bash 输出编码修复：命令 stdout/stderr 分别识别 UTF-8 和 GBK 输出，修复 Windows 中文输出乱码或解码失败；无法完整解码的输出使用 UTF-8 替换无效字符，交付文件统一为 UTF-8。编码处理不重复执行命令，并保留退出码、超时及取消状态。
  • 🪟 Windows Shell 识别与提示修复：修复 PATH 中 pwsh.exe、powershell.exe 的识别，按 PowerShell 7、Windows PowerShell、cmd 的顺序选择；工具说明明确实际 Shell、启动方式和命令语法，避免将工具名称 bash 误认为实际使用 Bash，保留用户环境加载能力。
  • 🩹 工具参数错误历史修复：修复参数格式错误的工具调用留在历史后导致后续消息无法发送的问题。查询模型历史时，在工具保留数量、历史轮次和上下文预算筛选之前排除非法参数调用及对应结果，并同步排除其历史 token 用量；覆盖 OpenAI Chat Completions、Responses 和 Anthropic。界面保留失败记录，合法参数对应的业务执行失败继续保留。
  • 📄 MCP 大结果分页：mcp.call 超限后保存完整 UTF-8 JSON，只返回摘要和文件信息，用普通 Bash 命令按路径分批读取；全局字符上限默认 8000、最小 1024，保留 MCP 原始错误状态。
  • 🐚 Bash 大结果分页：普通 Agent 和编码会话将超限 stdout/stderr 保存为 UTF-8 临时文件，只返回执行状态、摘要和文件地址，用普通 Bash 命令按路径分批读取，无需重新执行。返回上限默认 8000、最小 1024 字符，不因输出量终止进程，保留超时与取消。
  • 🧰 精简项目工具：移除 IDE 构建与 Inspection 工具，构建、编译、打包和检查通过 Bash 执行项目自身命令；保留文件读写、查找、搜索与 IDE 格式化。
  • 🧭 CLI 按需帮助：工具描述列出各指令简短用途，doc 提供索引，<指令> --help 返回详细参数。
  • 📂 本地资源路径：Markdown 链接、本地音视频及原生多模态工具支持工作区外绝对路径；相对路径仍按会话工作区解析，原生资源工具支持当前附件 ID。
  • 🖼️ Markdown 图片：拉伸铺满固定缩略图区域，大图查看器等比显示，保留缩放、旋转、复制与下载。
  • 🎛️ 模型参数布局：高级参数分组展示，按可用宽度切换列数，完善中文标签与短窗口滚动布局。
  • 🛠️ 外置插件开发 Skill：仓库提供用户自行安装的技能，包含 Maven、Gradle Shadow、IDEA Gradle Shadow、JS 模板，以及 SDK/Helper、生命周期、多项目缓存、多开、函数和打包手册，不增加专用开发工具或自动安装入口。
  • 🐞 独立插件沙箱调试：新增沙箱调试器，使用当前宿主 JetBrains IDE 与已安装的 JTools 插件运行独立 IDE 进程；支持临时加载插件、Swing 自动化、JVM 断点、JCEF/CDP 调试、异步操作查询和截图。进程隔离不等同于 OS 安全沙箱。
  • ⏳ 断点暂停下的异步 CDP：可能暂停的 CDP 调用可异步提交并按操作 ID 查询；连接释放后显式失败，超时不代表取消，也不应因此重发操作。

🚀 Version v1.1.5.8

  • 📂 Project-Scoped MCP, Skills, and SubAgents: Configure MCP services, Skills, and SubAgents for a specific project and its development workflow. Project-specific tools, instructions, and subagents are available only within that project, keeping each project’s capabilities focused and isolated.
  • 🧩 Global and Project Resource Management: Keep reusable resources at global scope and maintain project-specific MCP services, Skills, and SubAgents independently under the project’s .jtools directory. Management pages and CLI commands provide explicit global/project scopes.
  • 🖼️ On-Demand Multimodal Input: Initial and appended attachments provide metadata first; resource tools load content when needed. Native model capabilities take priority, with configured processing Agents handling unsupported modalities. Loaded content stays within the current turn, while later history retains summaries.
  • ⏱️ Resource Limits and Timeouts: Multimodal tools accept up to three resources per call. Environments, Agents, and project SubAgents can configure a separate timeout for each delegated resource tool; unset values inherit the processing Agent’s runtime limit, or 120 seconds when neither is configured.
  • 📍 Local Resources in Markdown: Open local file links in the IDE with line and column navigation to inspect project resources referenced in replies.
  • 🔍 Unified Image Preview: Markdown images, composer attachments, and user-message images share a viewer with zoom, rotation, and original-size / fit-to-window controls. Copy and download actions in the bottom toolbar use the JS bridge to copy image data or open the IDE save dialog; local downloads preserve the original file contents.
  • 🐛 Image Toolbar Fix: Removed the duplicate dialog that blocked the viewer controls and caused zoom and rotation to stop working. The viewer now participates in host popup-state management.
  • 🎛️ Configuration and Navigation: Place compact modality controls beside the context-window field on the same row, improve resource management, and standardize the management menu labels.
  • 🛠️ Tool Argument Failures: Invalid JSON or non-object arguments in a completed tool call now produce a tool failure with the original arguments and call identity, allowing the model to correct the call without retrying the whole response. Covers streaming and non-streaming Chat Completions, Responses, and Anthropic APIs.
  • 🌐 JCEF Dependency Fix: Added an optional Web Browser (JCEF) dependency for 2026.2+ while earlier IDEs use platform JCEF. The download handler binds to the runtime void/boolean callback contract. One ZIP supports builds 251.0–263.* (2025.1–2026.3).
  • 🎞️ Media Rendering: Local audio/video references use session-authorized streaming with byte-range seeking. Failed media shows an explicit error and original-file link. Unsupported JCEF codecs (H.264/H.265/AAC) require a supported format such as WebM (VP8/VP9 + Opus). Image thumbnails fill fixed frames; the preview fits a fixed viewport with zoom, rotate, copy, and download controls.
  • 🔧 IDE API Compatibility: Replaced the settings page SwingX VerticalLayout with the IntelliJ layout. New IDEs use asynchronous editor opening and HtmlChunk tab tooltips, with host API selection for older IDEs. Editor snapshots use Application.runReadAction(Computable), retaining the 251–263 single-package range.
  • 📦 Version Metadata: Updated the plugin version to v1.1.5.8 and the SDK Helper version marker to 1158.
  • 📂 项目级 MCP、Skills 与 SubAgent：面向不同项目的专属开发流程，新增项目级 MCP、Skills 与 SubAgent。项目定制的工具服务、技能指令和子代理仅在所属项目中可用，让能力配置更贴合项目需求，避免项目间相互干扰。
  • 🧩 全局与项目资源管理：保留全局资源供多个项目复用，同时在项目根目录的 .jtools 下独立维护 MCP 服务、Skills 和 SubAgent；管理页面和 CLI 支持明确选择全局或项目范围。
  • 🖼️ 多模态按需读取：附件首次输入与运行中追加只发送元数据；模型需要内容时再调用资源工具。模型原生模态能力优先，不支持的模态可交给配置的处理 Agent；同轮保留资源，跨轮历史仅保留摘要。
  • ⏱️ 资源工具限额与超时：多模态工具每次最多处理 3 个资源。环境、Agent 和项目 SubAgent 可为各类委派资源工具设置独立超时；留空时沿用处理 Agent 的最大运行时间，均未设置时为 120 秒。
  • 📍 Markdown 本地资源：支持通过本地文件链接打开 IDEA 文件并定位行列，回复中引用的项目资源可直接查看。
  • 🔍 统一图片预览：Markdown 图片、输入框附件和用户消息图片共用查看器，支持放大、缩小、原始尺寸／适应窗口及左右旋转。底部工具栏新增复制图片和下载图片，通过 JS 桥接写入系统剪贴板或打开 IDEA 保存对话框，本地图片下载保留原始文件内容。
  • 🐛 图片预览工具栏修复：移除与查看器同时打开的重复弹窗，解决遮挡操作区导致缩放、旋转失效的问题，并将查看器纳入宿主弹层状态管理。
  • 🎛️ 配置与导航优化：模型多模态能力以紧凑按钮组放在上下文窗口右侧并保持同一行；完善资源管理界面，并统一右上角管理菜单命名。

  • 🌐 新版 IDE JCEF 依赖修复：通过可选依赖连接 2026.2+ 的 Web Browser (JCEF) 插件，旧版沿用平台内置 JCEF；下载处理器按运行时接口适配 void / boolean 返回值，同一个安装包支持 251.0–263.*（2025.1–2026.3）。
  • 📦 版本元数据同步：插件版本升级到 v1.1.5.8，SDK Helper 版本标识同步为 1158。

🚀 Version v1.1.5.7

  • 🎛️ Model-Level History Token Ratio: History character-to-token estimation is now configured per model through the existing execution_params.history_token_ratio JSON field without adding a database column.
  • 🧮 Coding Context Budget Alignment: Coding sessions read the ratio from model_snapshot.execution_params.history_token_ratio for history estimates, context budgeting, occupancy metrics, and compaction estimates.
  • ♻️ Legacy Compatibility: Older models and session snapshots without the field use 0.4; ordinary Agent history also follows the active model's configured ratio and defaults to 0.4 when unset.
  • 🖥️ Unified Model Management: Web, Swing, and CLI model management support editing, saving, and displaying the ratio, while the field is excluded from OpenAI/Anthropic request bodies.
  • 📍 Stable Timeline Expansion: Expanding reasoning, tool, and SubAgent details preserves the target event position, preventing scroll drift when details load or content height changes.
  • 🖼️ Multimodal Resource Path Support: view_* resource tools now accept workspace-relative paths, ordinary absolute paths, and IntelliJ VFS URLs such as file://, jar://, and jrt://, so images and other resources can be loaded correctly for resource-Agent analysis while ordinary project-file tools retain their workspace boundaries.
  • 🧹 Global Setting Retired from Runtime: Existing message.history_token_ratio data is retained, but it is no longer read or shown in global settings.
  • ⏹️ Responsive Model Cancellation: The stop action now cancels the active model or tool batch from memory before querying task state, so it is not blocked by the database's global write lock; the task list refreshes when the task has already completed or its state is ambiguous.
  • ✅ Validation: Plugin build, targeted Kotlin tests, and Agent Web production build pass.
  • 🎛️ 模型级历史 Token 字符比例：历史消息字符到 Token 的估算比例改为按模型配置，复用已有 execution_params.history_token_ratio JSON 字段，不新增数据库列。
  • 🧮 编码会话上下文预算对齐：编码会话从 model_snapshot.execution_params.history_token_ratio 读取比例，统一影响历史估算、上下文预算、占用统计和压缩估算。
  • ♻️ 旧数据兼容：旧模型和旧会话快照缺少字段时使用 0.4；普通 Agent 也按当前模型配置的比例估算，未配置时默认使用 0.4。
  • 🖥️ 模型管理入口统一：Web、Swing 和 CLI 模型管理支持配置、保存和回显该比例，且不会将其发送到 OpenAI/Anthropic 请求体。
  • 📍 对话展开位置稳定：展开推理、工具和 SubAgent 详情时保持目标事件位置，避免详情加载或内容高度变化导致滚动漂移。
  • 🖼️ 多模态资源路径支持：view_* 资源工具支持工作区相对路径、普通绝对路径及 file://、jar://、jrt:// 等 IntelliJ VFS 协议路径，图片等资源可正确读取并交给资源 Agent 分析；普通项目文件工具仍保持工作区边界。
  • 🧹 停止读取全局比例：保留已有 message.history_token_ratio 数据，但运行时和全局设置页不再读取或展示。
  • ⏹️ 模型回复停止响应修复：停止操作优先从内存取消活动模型或工具批次，避免任务状态查询被数据库全局写锁阻塞；任务已完成或状态不明确时自动刷新任务列表。
  • ✅ 验证：插件构建、目标 Kotlin 测试和 Agent Web 生产构建均通过。
